subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is an original fictional 45-year-old European man with pale lightly weathered skin, a narrow long face, grey-blue eyes, a prominent straight nose, shoulder-length dark auburn hair parted in the middle and a neatly trimmed auburn beard with a few grey strands. He has a tall slender build. He wears a midnight-blue high-collar wool coat with understated antique-brass clasps over a cream linen shirt, a brown leather belt, black trousers and plain black leather boots. Realistic restrained fantasy costume, no magic effects, no hat, no eyewear.
The setting is a seamless plain light-grey studio background, soft even neutral studio lighting.

summary:
[] Generate <Subject 1>, in a seamless plain light-grey studio background, soft even neutral studio lighting.

retention_analysis:


detailed_description: A single photorealistic studio reference portrait of <Subject 1>. Exactly one image, no panels or collage. Front-facing, eyes looking at the camera, neutral relaxed expression, head upright. Show the complete hairstyle with clear space above and beside the head, neck, shoulders and upper torso. Both eyes and both sides of the face are clear. Soft even neutral lighting and natural skin texture. The background is plain light grey. No text or lettering. The camera is locked off and static; the scene holds still with no camera motion.

overall_soundscape: A silent still image.
